items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions B. B. King; Interviewee responds to the interviewer's comment about B. B. King's records but provides no personal anecdote or connection.

ctx.x: : I mean, there are very funny things. I mean, you take B. B. King, who was doing pretty well. If you hear him in person, he has a great little band, sounds great. But the records they make are terrible. You know, they're all hammed up, the material is rough.

Well, that's it. They take all the equipment and put behind somebody who doesn't have the quality and make them sound good. But they won't take the equipment and things that they need to put behind somebody that's already good to make them sound better, you know.
